lede.purpose: Muted paragraph under a display heading.

shadows.name: header-scrolled

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Filled buttons on hover, with a 1px lift.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Text field focus halo, with a teal border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Buttons, option rows, finder swap fade.

motion.name: state-slow
motion.purpose: Nav underline, radio dot, card lift and shadow.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.9s, transform 1.1s from translateY(28px), filter 0.9s from blur(6px); stagger 90ms per --i
motion.purpose: Default scroll-in reveal, triggered at 12% visibility with an -8% bottom root margin.

motion.name: hero-lines
motion.value: transform 1.15s from translateY(105%) inside a clipping line; delay 120ms + 110ms per line
motion.purpose: Hero headline lines rise from a mask on load.

motion.name: finder-swap
motion.value: fade, translateY(6px), blur(3px); content swapped after 220ms
motion.purpose: Office finder crossfade of number and address.

motion.name: border-moment
motion.value: columns from ±36px over 1.2s; dashed border draws down 1s at 0.55s; foot opens from centre 1s at 0.95s; shadow arrives at 0.9s
motion.purpose: The one authored scroll moment, on the cross-border comparison.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition and animation durations 0.01ms; scroll-behavior auto; reveals never hide content
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and the no-JS default.

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like a well-run practice's front desk: tidy, light, unhurried, and always ready with the right phone number. It is the category standard played straight and well, a clean modern professional-services site, and its character comes from usefulness rather than ornament. The nearest office and its number sit in the first viewport; the two tax systems are laid side by side in plain words; the directors are named.

Visually it is white ground, pale teal-grey bands, black geometric headings that echo the wordmark, and the logo's teal as the single accent. Surfaces are rounded cards with hairline borders and soft, long, blue-tinted shadows. Density is generous: large body text (about 17-20px), wide section padding, short measures. Motion is smooth and quiet: content fades up out of a slight blur as it scrolls in, hero lines rise from a mask, and one authored moment on the cross-border comparison. Everything still reads with motion reduced and with JavaScript off.

The old site's styling is explicitly discarded; nothing here should recall it.
keyCharacteristics: One accent: the logo teal, in three working shades, on buttons, links, selection, focus and one closing band.
Black Jost headings at weight 600 with tight negative tracking, matching the wordmark.
White and pale teal-grey alternating section bands; ink-black footer.
Rounded cards (14px), hairline borders, soft long shadows, pill buttons.
Smooth scroll-in reveals on one long ease, always off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only hue. No second accent colour is introduced; emphasis comes from weight, size and the three teal shades.

rules.name: The Ink-for-Text Teal-for-Marks Rule
rules.body: Small teal text uses `teal-ink` (6.7:1 on white); the brighter `teal` is for strokes, fills and marks. White text never sits on `teal`, only on `teal-ink` or darker.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: A full teal ground appears once per page, in the closing call-to-action band (and in the narrow foot of the cross-border comparison). Other sections alternate white and `surface`.

rules.name: The Wordmark Echo Rule
rules.body: Headings are always Jost 600 in `ink` with negative tracking (-0.015em for titles down to -0.04em for display). No light or italic display weights, no uppercase headings.

rules.name: The No-Tracked-Caps Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase belongs to the logo's tagline alone. No other text is set in spaced capitals.

rules.name: The Lockup Rule
rules.body: The wordmark is set in live type: the name at 600, -0.035em, and the tagline beneath it at a quarter of the name's size, 0.1em tracked capitals in teal, right-aligned under the name as in the logo. On phones the wordmark takes its own row and grows (up to 1.9rem) so the tagline stays legible. The proportion is a logo reproduction, not a type size for anything else.

rules.name: The One Raised Object Rule
rules.body: Each surface has at most one raised object. Everything else sits flat or at resting lift.

rules.name: The Single Wash Rule
rules.body: Soft radial glows are allowed only as one large, faint wash per band: `surface-2` behind the hero's top right, and 12% white in the closing band. No other gradients.

dos: Do keep teal the only accent, and use `teal-ink` for any teal text or any fill carrying white text.
Do set every heading in Jost 600 `ink` with negative tracking, balanced wrapping and a ch-based cap.
Do alternate white and `surface` section bands, with the teal band used once, at the close.
Do put phone numbers in tabular lining figures and make each one a `tel:` link.
Do use 14px rounded white cards with 1px `line` borders and the teal-tinted soft shadows from the vocabulary.
Do use pill buttons and inline 24px line icons at 1.75 stroke.
Do run all motion on the one long ease, keep content visible without JavaScript, and switch motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, or set white text on the brighter `teal`.
Don't set text in tracked uppercase; that treatment belongs to the logo tagline alone.
Don't use hard, offset or dark-edged shadows; depth is soft, long and teal-tinted.
Don't add gradients beyond the single faint radial wash per band.
Don't raise more than one object per surface with the raised shadow.
Don't add another authored scroll sequence; the cross-border comparison is the one, and everything else uses the standard fade-up reveal.
Don't bring back any styling from the firm's old site.
